name: PassFailAgent
description: Turns Output Validation's deterministic checks and grounded judgements into a verdict per test (failed = app defect, passed, inconclusive = MTA could not drive the UI or judge the output, not_executed) with evidence strength (E5 deterministic, E4 judged), and a runtime verdict per acceptance criterion (refuted / supported / unverified); updates TestCase rows and emits legacy-shaped execution_results for traceability and scoring.

inputs.name: evidence_collection
inputs.description: Bundles for errors, durations and actual output

outputs.name: pass_fail
outputs.description: counts, pass_rate, tests[{test_code, criterion_code, verdict, score, strength, decided_by, reasons, supporting_issues, actual_output}], criteria[{criterion_code, statement, runtime_verdict, strength, passed, failed, inconclusive, not_executed, mixed}]

outputs.name: execution_results
outputs.description: Legacy live-execution shape consumed by requirement traceability and compliance scoring

outputs.name: live_reachable
outputs.description: True when at least one test executed

outputs.name: live_status
outputs.description: 'connected' when at least one test executed
